//: A project of its own, with its own lockfile and pnpm-workspace.yaml, so sharp and png-to-ico never reach web/node_modules. There app code could import them: it would typecheck, lint and run under `make web`, then fail in web/Dockerfile's install with a green local build. Keeping them here preserves the property `make icons` is built around — that an image toolchain is not a frontend dependency.
name: songfolio-icons
